name: CloseDay
caption: Balans / Sistem servisi / Əməliyyat gününün bağlanması

datasets.name: SB_CloseDay
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  DESCRIPTION,
  QUERY,
  INTERNAL,
  HINT,
  ID
FROM
  SB_CLOSEDAY
WHERE
  INTERNAL=1
ORDER BY
  ID

datasets.name: ControlData
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  DESCRIPTION,
  QUERY,
  INTERNAL,
  HINT,
  ID
FROM
  SB_QUERIES
WHERE
  INTERNAL=1
ORDER BY
  ID

datasets.name: ODS_Settings
datasets.sql:
select s.RowID, nvl(s.Value,0) Value from Settings s
where upper(s.Name) = 'TRANSACTION_COMMIT'

datasets.name: ODS_NewDate
datasets.sql:
SELECT MIN(c.dat) 
  FROM (
    SELECT sbop.get_date + LEVEL AS dat
    FROM dual
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 20  -- Look for the next 20 days (you can adjust this number)
  ) c
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM calendar cal
    WHERE cal.holiday_date = c.dat
  )
